name: Lana Oleyn
source:
A renowned witch that owns a bakery in Parinea. She earned the respect and admiration of the locals by protecting her homeland against slime monsters during the war. 

Lana enjoys drinking all kinds of herbal teas and eating savoury muffins. She has a calm demeanour and a dry sense of humour.

[From [url=https://www.witpopgames.com/bakedmagic.html]official website[/url]]
